CARD AI LEGAL

Privacy Policy

Version date: November 17, 2026

×

This Privacy Policy explains how Card AI: TCG Card Scanner (“Card AI,” “we,” “us,” or “our”) collects, uses, stores, discloses, and deletes information when you use our iOS and Android applications and related account and support services (the “Service”). Platform-specific practices are identified below.

For privacy questions or requests, contact support@tcgcard.fun. Our website is https://tcgcard.fun.

1. Information We Collect and Why

Account and sign-in information

When you register or sign in, we process your email address, account or provider user ID, authentication information, account settings, and session information to create and secure your account. Email-and-password registration involves processing the credentials you submit. Supported third-party sign-in methods provide authentication results and the account information authorized by that method. We do not receive your Google or Apple account password when you use their sign-in services.

Android supports guest access, email-and-password accounts, and Google sign-in. iOS offers the sign-in methods displayed in the iOS app. An email address ending in gmail.com is treated as an email address; using it with a Card AI password is different from using Google sign-in.

Guest access does not require you to supply an account email, but use of the Service may still generate scan records, technical identifiers, and usage information.

Card images and scan records

When you scan a card or import a photo for recognition, the image is uploaded to our server for identification. We process the image and associated recognition results to provide scanning and scan-record features. Uploaded scan images and associated scan records are stored until you delete the relevant platform account, unless you delete them earlier using an available deletion feature.

We do not use your uploaded images or scan records to train machine-learning or AI models. Processing an image with an existing recognition model is used to provide the requested recognition result.

We use the camera when you initiate scanning and grant the necessary permission. Photo import accesses images you select or authorize through your device's photo-access controls. You can manage these permissions in device settings. Refusing permission may prevent the corresponding scanning or import feature from working.

Collections and information you enter

We store collection and Wishlist records, folder names, card selections, quantities, finishes, languages, purchase prices, grading details, preferences, and other information you enter into supported features. We use these records to organize your collection and provide price references, collection values, and related charts. A manually entered card purchase price is collection data; it is not your payment-card or bank-account information.

Search and app activity

Search terms, such as card names or numbers, are sent to our systems when needed to return search results. We do not maintain a saved user search-history feature. Processing a search request is separate from displaying or storing a searchable history in the app.

Our analytics services process configured events such as screen views, button taps, sessions, and scan success or failure. We use these events to understand feature usage and improve the app. Search-related events may record use of the search feature; this does not itself mean that the text of every search is included in analytics.

Device information, diagnostics, and approximate location

The app and its SDKs process device and app information, such as device model, operating-system and app versions, language, IP address, app-instance and installation identifiers, and configured usage events. Firebase Crashlytics processes crash reports, stack traces, relevant application and device state, and installation identifiers to diagnose errors.

Analytics services may derive approximate location, such as country, region, or city, from your IP address. This does not require your device's location permission. We do not request or collect precise GPS location.

Advertising attribution

We use Singular and relevant analytics integrations to measure installation sources and advertising campaign results. This may involve advertising identifiers when available and permitted, install-referrer information, IP address, device/app details, and configured conversion events.

The Android app does not display in-app advertisements. Attribution is used to measure advertisements for Card AI shown outside the app. Having no in-app advertisements does not mean that attribution data is not processed.

On iOS, access to the advertising identifier and tracking subject to Apple's permission requirements depend on the applicable device permission. On Android, the availability of the advertising identifier depends on device settings and applicable platform controls.

iOS purchases

Apple handles payment for purchases made through the App Store. To determine iOS access to purchased features, the iOS app uses purchase and subscription information supplied by Apple, such as product identifiers, transaction information, and current entitlement status. We do not receive your complete payment-card details from Apple.

The current Android release has no subscriptions or in-app purchases. Apple purchase rights are not used to restrict access to the free Android release.

Support communications

If you email us or submit a support or deletion request, we process your contact information, message, and any attachments you voluntarily provide to respond and handle the request. We do not access your email inbox or collect unrelated emails from your device.

2. How We Use Information

We process information to:

  • Provide scanning, search, collection management, and price-reference features.

  • Register, authenticate, and manage accounts and sessions.

  • Store and retrieve records within the relevant platform account.

  • Determine iOS purchase access and provide free Android access.

  • Analyze feature usage, diagnose crashes, and improve reliability.

  • Measure advertising and installation attribution.

  • Respond to support requests and send necessary account or service notices.

  • Protect the Service against unauthorized access and abuse, and meet applicable legal obligations.

We do not use card images or scan records for model training. A reference to product improvement in this policy does not authorize such training.

Where applicable law requires a legal basis, processing is based on providing the service you request, our legitimate interests in operating and protecting the Service where permitted, compliance with legal obligations, or consent where required. You may withdraw consent for consent-based processing without affecting processing that was lawful before withdrawal.

3. Android and iOS Data Separation

Android and iOS have separate platform accounts and personal data spaces, even where they use shared databases or authentication infrastructure.

Signing in with the same email address or identity provider on both platforms does not automatically merge or synchronize collections, Wishlist, folders, scan images or records, preferences, or collection-value records. Public card catalog and price-reference data may be shared between platforms.

Apple purchase entitlements apply to iOS. Android free access is separate. Deleting one platform account does not delete the separate account or records on the other platform. A shared authentication record needed for the other active platform may remain for that purpose; it does not restore the deleted platform account.

4. Service Providers and Other Recipients

Our analytics, attribution, and crash-reporting SDK providers are Firebase, Mixpanel, and Singular.

Provider or recipient Relevant information and purposes
Firebase / Google Analytics for Firebase App-instance identifiers, device/app information, configured usage events, and IP-derived approximate location for usage analysis.
Firebase Crashlytics Crash reports, diagnostics, application/device state, installation identifiers, and any diagnostic context attached to reports, to investigate and fix errors.
Mixpanel Configured events, user or pseudonymous identifiers, device/app information, and IP-derived approximate location for product analytics.
Singular Available advertising identifiers, install/referrer and attribution information, IP address, device/app details, and configured conversion events for campaign measurement.
Google and Apple sign-in services Authentication information and authorized account information when you choose a supported sign-in method. Apple sign-in is an iOS feature.
Apple App Store Purchase, subscription, and entitlement information for iOS purchases; Apple independently handles billing and its own transaction records.
Infrastructure service providers The account, collection, image, and technical data needed to host and operate our servers, databases, and recognition services.

Advertising attribution integrations may send relevant identifiers and conversion events to the advertising platforms connected to those campaigns. The information involved depends on the enabled integration and applicable permissions. This does not authorize disclosure of scan images or collection contents for advertising.

Service providers processing data on our behalf are distinct from independent services you choose to visit or use. Transfers to a processor may still be described in this policy even where they are exempt from the specific “sharing” label in Google Play's Data safety form.

Provider privacy information:

  • Google Privacy Policy

  • Firebase Privacy and Security

  • Mixpanel Privacy Policy

  • Singular Privacy Policy

  • Apple Privacy Policy

We may also disclose information when legally required, to address security incidents or protect legal rights, or in connection with a business transfer subject to applicable privacy obligations. If you choose to share content through another app or open an external marketplace, the recipient's own practices apply.

We do not sell personal information for money. Where applicable law treats advertising-related disclosure as “sharing,” a “sale,” or targeted advertising, you may exercise the applicable rights by contacting us.

5. Retention and Deletion

Records on our servers

We retain your platform account, collection records, uploaded scan images, and scan records to provide the Service until you delete that platform account or delete individual records through an available feature.

When a verified account deletion is executed, the account and its associated information on our own servers are deleted immediately, without a scheduled waiting period. We do not retain those deleted account records on our servers for later account recovery. The immediate deletion statement concerns execution of the deletion operation; an emailed request may first require support review and identity verification.

Records held by third parties

Deleting your Card AI account does not automatically or immediately erase records already held in Firebase, Mixpanel, Singular, Apple, or other third-party systems. Analytics, attribution, and diagnostic records in those systems are subject to the relevant service's retention settings, deletion mechanisms, and applicable legal requirements. We do not represent that these records disappear at the same time as our server records.

For requests concerning personal information held by providers in connection with Card AI, contact us at support@tcgcard.fun. We handle requests according to applicable rights and available provider procedures. Independent provider accounts, such as your Google or Apple account, must be managed through the provider. Apple's transaction records are governed by Apple's own obligations and policies.

Support correspondence and deletion-request communications are separate from your in-app collection records and may remain in the systems used to handle your request for as long as necessary to resolve it and meet applicable legal obligations. If a legal requirement prevents deletion of particular information, we will explain the applicable reason and scope where permitted.

6. How to Delete Your Account

You can initiate deletion through Delete Account in the app's account settings. You can also use our account deletion webpage without reinstalling the app, or email support@tcgcard.fun.

Specify Android or iOS and identify the account you want deleted. If the webpage opens an email draft, you must send that email to submit the request. We may need to verify that the request comes from the account holder. Do not send passwords or verification codes. For guest data, contact support so we can help identify the relevant records.

Deletion removes the selected platform account and its associated server records, including collections, Wishlist, folders, saved card details, scan images and records, and preferences, and ends access through that platform account's sessions. To use an account on that platform again, you must register again. Signing in with the same email or Google account does not recover deleted data.

The separate account and records on the other platform remain unaffected. If you want both deleted, request deletion for both platforms. Deletion does not delete your Apple or Google account.

Deleting Card AI or its iOS account does not cancel an Apple subscription. Manage or cancel that subscription in your Apple account's subscription settings. Canceling a subscription is not a prerequisite for submitting a Card AI account-deletion request. Uninstalling the app alone does not delete a server-side account.

7. Your Rights and Choices

Depending on your location, you may have rights to access, correct, delete, obtain a copy of, restrict, or object to processing of your personal information; withdraw consent; or opt out of applicable targeted advertising or sharing. You may also complain to the relevant data protection authority. Contact support@tcgcard.fun to exercise applicable rights. We may request proportionate verification to protect your information.

You can manage camera and photo permissions in device settings. You can manage available advertising-identifier controls on Android and tracking permissions on iOS. These controls do not necessarily stop all analytics, diagnostics, or information needed to operate your account. We do not imply that every data category has an in-app opt-out switch.

8. Security and International Processing

We use reasonable technical and organizational measures designed to protect information against unauthorized access, misuse, loss, and disclosure. Our production app-to-API connection uses HTTPS. No method of electronic transmission or storage is completely secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.

Information may be processed in countries where our infrastructure and service providers operate. Their laws may differ from those where you live. Applicable transfer and data-protection requirements continue to apply to such processing.

9. Children's Privacy

Card AI is intended for users aged 13 and older and is not directed to children under 13. Where applicable law requires a higher age or parental authorization, that requirement applies. Users below the age of majority need a parent or guardian's permission to use the Service.

If you believe a child has provided personal information contrary to these requirements, contact us so we can investigate and delete it as appropriate. Store content ratings describe content suitability and do not replace these eligibility requirements.

10. Changes and Contact

We may update this policy as the Service or our practices change. The version date identifies the revision; it takes effect when published on our website unless a later effective date is stated. We provide notice of material changes where required by law and obtain consent where legally required.
